mechanism_claims.claim_text: Br-f and Br-p show antibacterial phenotype against tested Gram-positive acne-associated strains, with Br-p stronger than Br-f; Gram-negative targets remain above the test-limit MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is phenotypic antimicrobial activity, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The primary paper proposes the Br-p fragment LRCDYGRFFASKSLYDPLKKRR as a cationic peptide with theoretical bacterial permease ligand activity from BIOPEP analysis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper does not directly assay permease binding or membrane permeabilization for the isolated fragment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Br-p has DPPH radical scavenging activity with an IC50 reported in the paper, supporting antioxidant context rather than antimicrobial mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: DPPH is not a microbial target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Br-p-modified chitosan/alginate/genipin dressing qualitatively reduced viable biofilm adhesion in CLSM images for P. acnes and S. aureus.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Local material provides qualitative microscopy context, not parser-supported exact biofilm quantity rows.
